gate: REPRODUCED iff R >= 1.30 on 4/4 fresh seeds {82021, 82022, 82023, 82024}. Else FAIL -> negative result with mechanism account (per standing evidence discipline: a failed replication is a landing).
hypothesis: H1: An INDEPENDENT implementation of the Episodic Contrastive Return (ECR) gain-update rule (return-conditioned, baseline-free, episodic credit assignment from the reward stream alone) beats frozen gains on canonical delayed_reward: R >= 1.30 on 4/4 fresh seeds. Mechanism: (1) episode boundaries detected from the reward stream alone (r>=1.0 terminal + max_steps truncation timeout); on success, the episode's branch choice (first branch_channels winner) AND the progress channel (argmax per-episode shaping receipts) are SET to the gain cap -- tied, so neither dominates/poisons t=0 (the K9 failure mode); (2) shaping-tick demotion of channels neither winner nor branch (stay suppressed, branches protected); (3) corridor boost for the shaping winner (forward); (4) pre-branch demotion -- a non-branch winner before any branch choice is a wasted no-op, demoted by prebranch_demote but floored at the branch-gain level (negative feedback without inverting into branch dominance).
metric: R = total_reward(learned)/total_reward(frozen) per seed, over the full 8-episode run (120 ticks max). Per-seed WIN iff R >= 1.30.
null: H0: independent ECR does not beat frozen gains (R < 1.30 on >= 1 of 4 seeds) -> replication fails -> mechanism account: which sub-mechanism (success lock-in, shaping demotion, corridor boost, pre-branch demotion, truncation detection) diverges, read from the gains trace vs the original's trace.
preregistered_before: any execution of the EXP-FP-0080 confirmatory driver on the preregistered seeds, and before the independent implementation module was written (spec-only reading completed; no code from attention_ecr.py reused)
rng_policy: seeded env RNG only (new_rng via env.reset with the preregistered seeds); neutral_specialists seeded per channel; no random.* in measurement code except seeded RNG declared here

documented_priors: max_steps (episode length bound, truncation detection only)
rule_summary.episode_boundary_detection: r>=1.0 (terminal) OR ep_ticks>=max_steps (truncation); reward-stream only, no env/obs read
rule_summary.predicted_failure_mode: If the replication fails, expected mechanism: (a) independent re-derivation mis-handles the pre-branch demote floor (demote below branch level -> branch dominance -> learned < frozen); (b) success lock-in misses the true progress channel on some seed; (c) truncation edge case at ep_ticks boundary. The gains trace (per-tick gain_history) will discriminate.

update_triggers.0 < r < 1.0: shaping: count toward progress-channel ID; demote non-{winner,branches} by shape_punish; boost winner by corridor_boost
update_triggers.r == 0 and pre-branch and winner not in: demote winner by prebranch_demote, floored at branch-gain level
update_triggers.r >= 1.0: successful episode: gain[branch_choice]=cap, gain[progress_channel]=cap; reset episode
